description: Fine inhalable particles with diameters 2.5 micrometers and smaller
notes: Primary criterion pollutant in India; penetrates deep into lungs and cardiovascular system

description: Inhalable particles with diameters 10 micrometers and smaller
notes: Primary thoracic coarse particulate matter; originates from road dust construction and windblown soils

description: Reddish-brown toxic gas produced from high-temperature combustion
notes: Combustion byproduct primarily from vehicular emissions and power plants

description: Toxic gas with a pungent irritating smell from sulfur-containing fuels
notes: Emitted predominantly by thermal power stations oil refineries and industrial smelting

description: Colorless odorless toxic gas formed by incomplete combustion of carbon-based fuels
notes: Canonical unit is mg/m3 per CPCB and WHO standards; note 1 mg/m3 = 1000 µg/m3

description: Secondary photochemical oxidant formed by VOCs and NOx in presence of sunlight
notes: Ground-level secondary pollutant; photochemically generated during peak daylight hours

description: Pungent alkaline gaseous compound of nitrogen and hydrogen
notes: Optional criterion pollutant; agricultural waste livestock and localized urban fertilizer emissions
